01

Long-distance marches

Events such as the Nijmegen Four Days Marches ask participants to manage repeated long days.

  • Check the organiser’s current registration and entry rules.
  • Train back-to-back sessions when the event requires them.
  • Practise recovery and foot care between days.
02

High-intensity endurance events

Challenges such as Mammutmarsch and other long-course events reward preparation and pacing.

  • Study the elevation profile and course cut-offs.
  • Train with your event-day pack and nutrition.
  • Use shorter test events to sharpen your plan.
03

Build your own challenge

A good local challenge needs a route, clear rules and a sensible safety margin.

  • Pick a measurable goal such as distance, ascent or time.
  • Share the plan with your group and give people options.
  • Review how it went rather than treating completion as the only result.
